name: Gayoung Lee
about: I am a part-time researcher at the Data Analytics Lab at UNIST, pursuing an M.S. degree at the Novatus Graduate School of Industrial AI. I also work as a Vision AI Engineer at DMTS, developing deep learning-based visual inspection systems for automotive manufacturing. My research focuses on the challenges of maintaining reliable and consistent performance of AI-based visual inspection systems under changing manufacturing environments.

milestones.title: B.S. in Industrial and Management Engineering (Double Major in Computer and Electronic Systems Engineering)
